SIM-BUG: LIL/LIU read-modify-write creates false pipeline dependency

LIL (regLoadBYTELower) at cpu.cpp:701-705 reads the full register, masks, and writes back. Hardware does direct partial assignment (regbnk.vhd:104) — no read needed. When LIU+LIL are back-to-back to same register, sim reads stale upper byte because LIU hasn't written back yet.

Fix: either (a) forward the partial write through the pipeline, or (b) match hardware behavior by tracking partial writes without read-modify-write.

Affects: LIW pseudo-instruction, any LIU+LIL sequence to same register.
Trace evidence: test_basic MW 0006 (GHDL=abcd, sim=00cd) and MW 0013 (GHDL=ff05, sim=0005).
